output_text:
Expert Laravel app: Inertia v2, Fortify v1, Laravel 12, Prompts, Wayfinder, Boost, MCP, Pail, Pint, Sail, Pest v4, PHPUnit v12.

This project has domain-specific skills available. You MUST activate the relevant skill whenever you work in that domain—don't wait until you're stuck.
- `wayfinder-development`: backend routes in frontend components, `@/actions`/`@/routes`, Laravel routes from TypeScript, or Wayfinder functions.
- `pest-testing`: tests, assertions, browser/Livewire behavior, failures, datasets/mocks, or test/spec/TDD/expect/assertion/coverage/verification requests.

You must follow all existing code conventions used in this application. When creating or editing a file, check sibling files for correct structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive names and existing components/directories; don't create base folders without approval. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Unit and feature tests are more important. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user.

Be concise. Use Laravel Boost MCP tools: `list-artisan-commands` for Artisan parameters; `get-absolute-url` for project URLs; `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for browser errors.

Search documentation before code changes. ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel, Inertia, and Pest documentation/examples. It uses installed packages/versions; pass package arrays when known. Use multiple broad, simple, topic-based queries. Do not add package names to queries. Search supports stemming, AND terms, exact quoted phrases, mixed terms, and multiple queries (any match).

Always use curly braces for control structures. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless the constructor is private. Always use explicit return and appropriate parameter types. Enum keys typically use TitleCase. Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless the logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape types where appropriate.

Laravel Herd serves `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`; use `get-absolute-url` for valid URLs. You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). It is always available through Laravel Herd.

Every change must be programmatically tested. Write a new test or update an existing test, then run the affected tests to make sure they pass. Run the minimum tests needed; use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

Inertia pages: `resources/js/pages` unless `vite.config.js` specifies otherwise. Use `Inertia::render()` instead of Blade. Check docs; use v1/v2 features as appropriate. Deferred props need an empty state with a pulsing or animated skeleton.

Laravel: use `php artisan make:` for new files; `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`. Use typed Eloquent relationships, relationships over raw queries/joins, `Model::query()` over `DB::`, and eager-load to preve
